Name: Immutable Audit
Description: Append-only audit logging system that captures all critical system operations with complete traceability. Guarantees compliance with ISO 55000:2014 Clause 7.5 (Documented information).
Normative References:
• ISO 55000:2014 Clause 7.5 (Documented information).
• ISO 27001:2022 A.12.4.1 (Event logging).
Scope: Applies to: configuration changes, maintenance operations, file management, data extraction, AI queries, equipment boundary modifications, and warranty decisions.

Name: Data Encryption at Rest
Description: Encryption standard for sensitive data stored on servers, databases, and mobile devices. Guarantees confidentiality according to ISO 27001:2022.
Normative References:
• ISO 27001:2022 A.8.24 (Use of cryptography).
• NIST SP 800-57 (Recommendation for Key Management).
Scope: Applies to: attachments, maintenance plans, technical documents, AI embeddings, mobile cache, and external API credentials.

Name: Data Integrity
Description: Integrity verification mechanism using cryptographic hashes to detect file and system log corruption or tampering.
Normative References:
• NIST FIPS 180-4 (Secure Hash Standard).
• ISO 27001:2022 A.8.24 (Use of cryptography for integrity).
Scope: Applies to: uploaded PDF/image files, downloaded mobile documents, local cache, and audit logs (TR-001).

Name: Rate Limiting
Description: Traffic control mechanism to prevent API abuse, protect expensive computational resources, and ensure equitable service availability.
Normative References:
• OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023): API4:2023 Unrestricted Resource Consumption.
• RFC 6585 Section 4: HTTP Status Code 429 (Too Many Requests).
Scope: Applies to: AI data extraction, RAG queries on documentation, external LLM APIs, and critical backend endpoints.

Name: Encryption in Transit
Description: Encryption policy for data in transit between client-server, server-DB, and server-external APIs. Guarantees network confidentiality and integrity.
Normative References:
• OWASP Transport Layer Protection Cheat Sheet.
• NIST SP 800-52 Rev. 2: Guidelines for TLS Implementations.
• ISO 27001:2022 A.8.24: Use of cryptography.
Scope: Applies to: HTTPS communications, encrypted database connections, external APIs, and mobile synchronization.

Name: RBAC Authentication and Authorization
Description: Role-Based Access Control system to manage user permissions. Implements the principle of least privilege.
Normative References:
• OWASP Authentication Cheat Sheet.
• NIST SP 800-63B: Digital Identity Guidelines (Authentication).
• ISO 27001:2022 A.5.15: Access control.
Scope: Applies to: all backend endpoints, CRUD operations, file access, and configuration modifications.

Name: Offline-First Synchronization
Description: Architectural pattern for mobile applications operating in intermittent connectivity environments. Allows offline data capture with deferred server synchronization.
Scope: Applies to: field data capture (WO closure), technical manual consultation (document viewer), and field equipment history consultation.

Name: ISO 14224 Hierarchy Management and Validation
Description: Centralized service to manage, validate, and query the hierarchical equipment classification according to ISO 14224:2016 (9 levels). Includes integrity validations that prevent duplicates, gaps, and broken references, as well as search and reporting capabilities by taxonomic level.
Normative References:
• ISO 14224:2016 Section 5: Boundary definitions and 9-level asset hierarchy requirement.
• ISO 14224:2016 Annex B: Asset hierarchy examples.
Scope: Applies to: L6/L8 equipment creation, component allocation, physical boundary definition, work order closure, maintenance scheduling, and equipment reports.

Name: AI / LLM Framework
Description: Centralized framework for Artificial Intelligence service integration into maintenance workflows. Includes confidence management, cost control, fallback to manual processing, and full auditability.
Normative References:
• OWASP LLM Top 10 (2024): Security risks in applications with LLM.
• NIST AI Risk Management Framework: Governance and auditability.
Scope: Applies to: PDF document data extraction, RAG queries on technical documentation, maintenance assistant, and work order analysis.

Name: Real-Time Synchronization
Description: Real-time update mechanism for critical data between backend and clients (web and mobile). Ensures all clients see immediate changes without needing page refreshes.
Normative References:
• RFC 6455: The WebSocket Protocol.
• OWASP WebSocket Security: Best practices.
Scope: Applies to: visualization layer updates (work permits, inventory), real-time status changes, critical event notifications, and user permission synchronization.

Name: HPHMI Philosophy
Description: Design standard for the Digital Twin interface based on Hollifield's philosophy. The goal is to minimize operator cognitive load through a 'boring' (grayscale) interface where color is reserved exclusively for abnormal conditions.
Normative References:
• HMI Philosophy (Hollifield): Chapters 6 & 7.
• ISA-101.01: Human Machine Interfaces for Process Automation Systems.
• WCAG 2.1 AA: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines.
Scope: Applies to: all 2D visualization dashboards, information layers over the 3D model, KPI indicators, and system navigation.
